title: Geometric Intuition Enables Resource-Efficient Screening for beta-Barrel-Like Folds in Viral Structural Dark Matter.
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于链连接性的几何规则框架Cooper-Beta，从预测蛋白质结构中高效筛选β-桶样折叠，虽非AI/物理模拟方法，但针对病毒蛋白结构暗物质进行结构计算筛选，与蛋白质结构计算课题相关。
abstract: Predicted protein structures now enable fold discovery beyond the reach of sequence homology, but scalable and interpretable methods remain limited. We present Cooper-Beta, a resource-efficient, chain-resolved framework for detecting beta-barrel-like folds from strand connectivity. Cooper-Beta converts DSSP-assigned physical beta-strands into an adjacency graph and evaluates four measurements using calibrated direct rules or logistic regression. On a grouped held-out benchmark of 466 positive and 1063 negative chains, the direct classifier achieved 87.77% recall and 97.65% specificity, while the learned classifier reached 94.42% recall and 97.08% specificity. A separate evaluation of 114 manually classified CATH Class II non-barrels yielded specificities of 95.61% and 92.98%, respectively. Both classifiers retained prediction-flip rates below 3% through 1.0 A Gaussian Calpha perturbation, with stronger learned-model sensitivity at higher noise. Screening 351 242 structures from the Big Fantastic Virus Database yielded 5803 joint-positive candidates; sequential Swiss-Prot and UniRef50 searches identified 1568 sequence-available candidates without a passing Swiss-Prot or UniRef50 match. Cooper-Beta provides an interpretable route from predicted structural repositories to beta-barrel-like candidates for experimental follow-up.
abstract_zh: 预测的蛋白质结构如今使得在序列同源性无法触及的范围内发现折叠成为可能，但可扩展且可解释的方法仍然有限。我们提出 Cooper-Beta，一种资源高效、按链解析的框架，用于从链连接性检测类β-桶折叠。Cooper-Beta 将 DSSP 指定的物理 β-链转换为邻接图，并使用校准的直接规则或逻辑回归评估四种测量。在包含 466 条阳性链和 1063 条阴性链的分组留出基准上，直接分类器达到 87.77% 的召回率和 97.65% 的特异性，而学习分类器达到 94.42% 的召回率和 97.08% 的特异性。对 114 条人工分类的 CATH Class II 非桶的单独评估分别产生了 95.61% 和 92.98% 的特异性。两种分类器在 1.0 A 高斯 Calpha 扰动下均保持低于 3% 的预测翻转率，学习模型在更高噪声下敏感性更强。筛选 Big Fantastic Virus Database 中的 351 242 个结构产生了 5803 个联合阳性候选；顺序 Swiss-Prot 和 UniRef50 搜索识别出 1568 个序列可得且没有通过 Swiss-Prot 或 UniRef50 匹配的候选。Cooper-Beta 提供了一条从预测结构库到类β-桶候选的可解释路径，以供实验跟进。
